messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 37):
"""
S No Item Particulars (to be filled by the Insurer) 4.27 Expected combined ratio (for the product) -to be furnished for each plan separately 4.28 Age-wise combined ratio- to be furnished for each plan separately 4.29 Sum insured-wise- combined ratio to be furnished for each plan separately 4.30 Age and sum insured wise combined ratio - to be furnished for each option or plan separately Table given below (SI band and age bands shall be increased / decreased depending on the minimum and maximum SI /Age offered) S.NO SI/Age bands 25000 50000 100000 150000 200000 1 >=0<=2 2 >=3<=15 3 >=16<=25 4 >=26<=30 5 >=31<=35 6 >=36<=40 7 >=41<=45 8 >=46<=50 9 >=51<=55 10 >=56<=60 11 >=61<=65 12 >=66 4.31 Expected cross-subsidy between age/sum insured/ plans etc.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What combined ratio figures must an insurer provide for each health insurance plan?","answer":"An insurer must furnish the expected combined ratio for each plan separately, as well as age-wise, sum insured-wise, and age-and-sum insured-wise combined ratios for each plan.","facts":["4.27 Expected combined ratio (for the product) -to be furnished for each plan separately","4.28 Age-wise combined ratio- to be furnished for each plan separately","4.29 Sum insured-wise- combined ratio to be furnished for each plan separately","4.30 Age and sum insured wise combined ratio - to be furnished for each option or plan separately"]},{"question":"What table format should insurers use to present combined ratios by age and sum insured bands?","answer":"Insurers should use a table with SI/Age bands such as 25000, 50000, 100000, 150000, 200000 and age bands ranging from 0-2 up to 66+, adjusting bands as needed.","facts":["SI/Age bands 25000 50000 100000 150000 200000","1 >=0<=2","2 >=3<=15","3 >=16<=25","4 >=26<=30","5 >=31<=35","6 >=36<=40","7 >=41<=45","8 >=46<=50","9 >=51<=55","10 >=56<=60","11 >=61<=65","12 >=66"]}]}
